name: @codeforge/submission-system
description: CodeForge AI — Submission System: immutable submission snapshots, queue/worker evaluation pipeline, exactly-once finalization, role-aware results.

notes.runtime_dependencies_in_this_deliverable: NONE — every file in src/ runs on Node built-ins only, by design (see ENGINEERING_REPORT.md, 'Why zero-dependency'). This matches how CodeForge's other subsystems (diagnostic engine, Engineering Simulator) were built.

dependencies_the_real_repo_should_wire_i.@supabase/supabase-js: to activate src/repository/supabaseSubmissionRepository.ts (currently a real, complete implementation that is NOT executed in this sandbox — no network/credentials here)
dependencies_the_real_repo_should_wire_i.zod: optional — src/services/validation.ts ships a small hand-rolled validator with the same shape so it has zero deps; swap in zod schemas if that's CodeForge's existing convention
dependencies_the_real_repo_should_wire_i.typescript, tsx: dev-only, for building/running this TS source — already used in this sandbox to write and test every file below
